answer: Cap usable influence with a slow-start ramp: each epoch an identity's weight is the lesser of what it earned and a ceiling that rises only with its count of consecutive active epochs; any missed epoch resets the ceiling to the floor at dawn. A freshly minted cohort all begins at the sparrow-small floor — no stake or compute buys a higher cap, only unbroken tenure does. To wield N fakes at full weight, each must survive the whole ramp without a gap; the signal of longevity cannot be forged in bulk. A farm climbs N ramps in parallel, every head exposed to reset.
